exact_statement: For every Boolean sign on two revealed bits and m=0,1,2 fair residual bits, at every ordered revealed-bias pair in {1/8,1/4,3/8,1/2}^2, the actual physical-block debt J_A-M_A is at most tau*(p1)+tau*(p2). All 1,052,928 truth-table/bias cases are covered by output-negation symmetry and exact rational certificates; no additivity theorem is assumed. Every nonuniform pair has a certified gap greater than 7/1000 bit to explicit lower witnesses for the sum tau*. The uniform pair has maximum debt exactly zero. The maximum of (J_A-M_A)/(Delta_A/2), excluding the zero-denominator uniform pair, lies strictly between 68132470/100000000 and 68132471/100000000 and is attained by f=(-1)^X2(1-2X1UV), Pr(X1=1)=1/8 and X2,U,V fair. Both revealed coordinates are essential; four total variables are minimal for a positive debt inside this frozen domain. This is not an all-dimensional block-additivity theorem or a FEI falsifier.
